name: Karen Martinez

bio.statement: Forest Grove's elections page lists Councilor Karen Martinez's seat as up for election in November 2026.
Martinez's pamphlet statement lists service on the Forest Grove City Council since 2023.
Martinez's pamphlet statement lists nursing education at the University of Portland School of Nursing.
bio.excerpt: Washington High School, Tacoma, WA; PCC; University of Portland School of Nursing Bachelor

bio.statement: Martinez's pamphlet statement says Forest Grove has been her home for over 33 years.
bio.excerpt: Forest Grove has been my home for over 33 years.

positions.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Martinez says she supports the bond for a new police station.
positions.excerpt: I support the bond for the new police station.

positions.statement: Martinez's pamphlet statement says police officers and firefighters deserve community support.
positions.excerpt: Police officers and firefighters deserve our support for putting their lives on the line to protect our community.

positions.statement: Martinez's pamphlet statement says closing homeless camps brought greater safety to Forest Grove.
positions.excerpt: Closing the camps brought greater safety to Forest Grove.

positions.statement: Martinez's pamphlet statement calls for accounting for every expense.
Martinez's pamphlet statement says she supported no field usage fees for youth sports.
positions.excerpt: Supported NO field usage fees for youth sports.
